'''Nost''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he ordered a bombing strike on Republic [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].<ref name="TOR" />
